change.title: pr-10
change.description: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding
change.author: Robin Ward

findings.title: Migration crashes on every site that has no embed_category set
findings.body: `execute(...)[0]['id']` assumes the join returns a row. `embed_category` defaults to `''` (the removed `config/site_settings.yml` entry), and a default isn't stored in `site_settings`. It is also missing when the stored name no longer matches a category. In each of these cases the query returns zero rows, and `PG::Result#[](0)` raises `IndexError` ("Index 0 is out of range"). The fallback on line 14 never runs, so the migration aborts and the deploy fails on most installs. Check `cmd_tuples`/`ntuples` before indexing, as line 19 already does for `embeddable_hosts`, and do the same for the `uncategorized_category_id` query on line 15.

findings.title: Migrated hosts aren't normalised, so hosts saved with a scheme or path stop matching
findings.body: The old setting accepted `http://eviltrout.com`, `https://example.com/1234` and similar values. The removed `allows_embeddable_host?` stripped the scheme or parsed the URI, and the removed specs covered both forms. This migration inserts each line raw. It skips the model's `before_validation` stripping, it doesn't trim `\r` or whitespace, and it doesn't skip blank lines. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` with the bare `uri.host` (`app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17`), so these rows never match. Embedding on those sites silently starts failing with 'invalid referer host', and TopicRetriever stops importing. Strip scheme, path and whitespace, drop empty lines, and quote the value (`ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote`) rather than interpolating it inside `'...'`. A host containing a quote currently breaks the SQL.

findings.title: A host saved with a port passes validation but can never match
findings.body: The format regex accepts `:port` (`(:[0-9]{1,5})?`), and `before_validation` keeps the port, because it strips only the scheme and the path. `record_for_host` compares the stored value with `uri.host` (line 14), which never contains a port. So `example.com:8080` saves successfully, and every embed from it is rejected with no hint why. Either strip the port before saving or compare against `host:port`. The `{2,5}` TLD limit also rejects valid hosts that the old `host_list` setting allowed, such as `.online`, `.technology`, IP addresses and `localhost`. Admins can't add those hosts, or edit migrated rows that contain them.

findings.title: After saving without choosing a category, the row shows no category although the server stored Uncategorized
findings.body: When the admin doesn't pick a category, `categoryId` is null. The server replaces it with `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` (`app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:25`). The client then sets `category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(null)`, which is undefined, so the badge renders empty until the page is reloaded. Set the category from the `category_id` the server returns instead of the locally chosen value.

findings.title: A failed delete gives no feedback
findings.body: `destroyRecord()` has no `.catch`. If the request fails, the row stays and nothing tells the admin why. `save` already uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`; do the same here.

findings.title: Unknown ids and a missing host param cause 500s instead of 404/422
findings.body: `where(id:).first` returns nil for an unknown id, so `save_host(nil)` and `host.destroy` raise NoMethodError. Likewise, `EmbeddableHost#before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` (`app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6`), which raises when `host` is nil. Use `find` (or raise `Discourse::NotFound`), and guard `host` for nil in the callback.

findings.title: Nothing prevents duplicate hosts, so the category for a host is ambiguous
findings.body: Nothing in the table or the model enforces uniqueness on `host`. `record_for_host` returns `.first` with no order, so if the same host exists twice with different categories, `TopicEmbed.import` puts topics into an arbitrary one. Consider a unique index on `lower(host)` and a matching uniqueness validation.

findings.title: The 'embeddable_host is blank' test no longer tests what its name says
findings.body: `expandable_first_post?` no longer looks at hosts (`app/models/topic.rb:869`). This example passes only because a built topic has no topic embed and `embed_truncate` defaults to false. The `Fabricate(:embeddable_host)` in the nested `before` (line 1409) has no effect either. Rename or remove the example, and drop the unneeded fabrication.

findings.title: Fabricator file contents are swapped
findings.body: `category_fabricator.rb` now defines `:embeddable_host`, and `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` holds all the category fabricators. Swap the contents back so each file matches its name.

findings.title: `find('fruit', 2)` actually tests fruit 1
findings.body: The pretender route `/fruits/:id` always returns `fruits[0]` (`test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:227`). The assertions expect apple's `color_ids` [1,2], while banana (id 2) has [3]. The test passes only because the id is ignored. Use `find('fruit', 1)`, or have the pretender honour the id.

findings.title: Plural hydration crashes on null and leaves undefined entries
findings.body: `obj[k].map` throws when an `*_ids` key is null. Ids that aren't in the root collection become `undefined` entries in the array. `hydrated || []` is dead code, because `map` always returns an array. Guard null and filter out unresolved ids.

findings.title: `type.replace('_', '-')` replaces only the first underscore
findings.body: A string pattern replaces only its first occurrence, so a future admin model like `site_text_type` wouldn't match its hyphenated form in ADMIN_MODELS. Use `/_/g`.

findings.title: PUT /admin/customize/embedding and `saveChanges` do nothing
findings.body: `update` re-renders the current state without changing anything. `saveChanges` (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:5`) calls it, but no template references that action. Remove both, or implement them.

contracts.action: Migration deletes the embeddable_hosts and embed_category site settings after copying them
contracts.equivalent_path: Old SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? read these settings, stripping the scheme or parsing the URI
contracts.before_after: Before: hosts with http://, https:// or a path matched. After: the rows are copied raw, and lookups compare against the bare uri.host.
contracts.visible_effect: Hosts saved with a scheme or path stop allowing embeds, and nothing reports it.
contracts.failure_mode: The migration runs in a single DDL transaction, so a failing INSERT rolls the DELETE back. However, the earlier [0] index raises before that on sites without embed_category. The DELETE removes only the two named settings.

contracts.equivalent_path: Other admin resources such as permalinks use REST destroy
contracts.before_after: New endpoint. It deletes the row with the given id, and the client removes the row from the list only on success.
contracts.visible_effect: The row disappears after the confirm dialog.
contracts.failure_mode: An unknown id raises NoMethodError (500). A client failure has no catch, so nothing is shown.

contracts.action: The embed referer check uses EmbeddableHost
contracts.before_after: The separate blank-setting check is gone. With no rows, host_allowed? returns false, so the result is the same rejection.
contracts.visible_effect: InvalidAccess is raised for hosts that aren't allowed.
contracts.failure_mode: A host stored with a port never matches.

contracts.action: TopicEmbed.import chooses the category from the host's record
contracts.equivalent_path: Previously SiteSetting.embed_category (a category name), resolved by TopicCreator#find_category
contracts.before_after: An integer id is now passed, which find_category handles by id. No record means nil, which means uncategorized.
contracts.visible_effect: Imported topics land in the host's category.
contracts.failure_mode: If duplicate host rows exist, the category is arbitrary.

contracts.action: The admin embedding screen loads its hosts through the store
contracts.equivalent_path: Store _hydrateEmbedded plural branch, together with ApplicationSerializer's embed :ids, include: true
contracts.before_after: embeddable_host_ids is resolved from root.embeddable_hosts, and category_id from Discourse.Category.
contracts.visible_effect: The table shows each host and its category badge.
contracts.failure_mode: A failed load surfaces as a normal route error.

summary: The migration blocks the merge. It indexes `[0]` into an empty result on any site where `embed_category` is unset (the default), so `IndexError` aborts the deploy. It also copies the old host list without normalising it: hosts saved with `http://`, `https://` or a path, which the old setting accepted, stop matching, and embedding fails without telling anyone. Other problems: a host saved with a port can never match; the TLD regex rejects longer TLDs and IP addresses; and after saving with no category chosen, the category badge is blank. The rest is minor: unknown ids return 500s, a failed delete shows nothing, there is a dead update endpoint, the fabricator files have swapped contents, and two tests no longer test what their names say.
